R821.note: Replaces attacker-controlled jku key resolution with a hardcoded trusted JWKS endpoint; other validation params unchanged.

R822.note: Path.startsWith(Path) correctly closes the sibling-directory string-prefix bypass with no other behavior change.

R823.note: mathjs.evaluate() is an appropriate safe evaluator for a calculator sink, closing eval() code execution.

R824.note: Rejects negative offset before unsigned conversion and does underflow-safe bounds math; preserves valid-range behavior.

R825.note: Narrows CSRF exemption to /api/webhooks/** exactly matching the stated design intent, restoring protection elsewhere.

R826.note: Allowlist approach is correct for ORDER BY injection, but the allowlist omits 'created_at', the controller's default sort value, so a plain request with no sort param now throws ArgumentException instead of succeeding -- a silent regression not mentioned in the write-up.

R827.note: Adds getSessionIdentifier bound to req.session.id, correctly binding tokens per session as the library requires.

R828.note: Adds getSessionIdentifier bound to req.session.userId; closes the reported cross-user token reuse, though binding by user rather than session is slightly looser than ideal (not flagged as a gap).

R829.note: Standard parameterized query with placeholders in correct order; behavior otherwise unchanged.

R830.note: Saves clientId to a local variable before the call that frees req, cleanly eliminating the UAF without touching the callee's freeing contract.

R831.note: Replaces DES/static-IV with AES-256-GCM and a random nonce; the new 32-byte key-length requirement is an inherent, disclosed consequence of the algorithm change.

R832.note: calloc(count, size) performs the standard overflow-checked allocation, correctly replacing the overflow-prone manual multiplication.

R833.note: Array-form exec() avoids shell tokenization of metacharacters, closing the reported command-injection sink.

R834.note: Changing i<=n to i<n is the exact, minimal fix for the off-by-one write.

R835.note: The fix only changes enqueue_completion/process_work_queue and adds a comment telling callers not to call handle_connection_reset() after enqueueing, but main() still does exactly that -- the same UAF still fires on the demonstrated path, and the added connection_release(&ctx->conn) call in process_work_queue now double-frees the connection already freed by handle_connection_reset().

R836.note: Parameterized ? placeholder replaces template-literal interpolation; standard mysql2 fix with no other change.

R837.note: Replaces leaked error.message/stack with a generic message, matching the app's own existing global-handler pattern.

R838.note: Character allowlist regex plus realpath containment check closes the dynamic-require injection while permitting normal plugin names.

R839.note: Adds SpaCsrfTokenRequestHandler to match the cookie-based token encoding, the documented fix for this exact mismatch.

R840.note: Scopes the query via the already-provided findByOwnerUsername repository method, matching the ownership pattern used elsewhere in the controller.

R841.note: Detects true MIME type from file bytes via python-magic and enforces an image allowlist, replacing trust in the client-supplied content_type.

R842.note: crypto.randomBytes() is the correct CSPRNG replacement for Math.random() for an invite-code sink.

R843.note: Moves the term into a Jinja2 {{ term }} placeholder relying on Flask's default autoescaping, correctly closing the XSS sink.

R844.note: Absolute-path prefix check with separator (avoiding the sibling-directory bypass) is inserted before both the directory and file creation paths, correctly closing zip-slip.
